scope: read-only; CPU only; no environments, training, optimizer steps on game weights, MPS, or writes outside this review directory

findings.location: hunk 'after each PPO update, before metrics/checkpoint publication'
findings.summary: No LR assertion before the first update; drift is detected only after optimizer.step() has used the wrong LR.
findings.fix: Assert effective LR immediately before each update call, not only after.

findings.summary: without_group_lr is undefined in the frozen runner (fingerprint is at runner.py:375; helper exists only in the test as optimizer_without_lr). Patch fails with NameError.
findings.fix: Define or import the helper from one shared module with the same scope as the test.

findings.summary: Registration check runs after the optimizer LR mutation, so a mismatched registration mutates and then raises.
findings.fix: Move the arm_transition check above the apply_resume_lr_override call.

findings.location: lr-transition.json record and arm_transition check; frozen runner.py:28 and :138 pin CONFIG_SHA
findings.summary: No code validator permits only ppo.learning_rate plus arm identity; lr-transition.json omits parent config SHA and arm config SHA, so the parent/arm identity transition is textual only.
findings.fix: Add a declared transition validator and record parent config SHA as archived provenance; require it before arm registration.

findings.summary: Patch is a sketch: hunk headers are comments without line numbers, and paths are placeholders (frozen-training-adapter/runner.py, future-registered-arm/runner.py), not git-applicable to the real runner. Anchor is correct at runner.py:596.
findings.fix: Label as sketch or regenerate as a real unified diff against the frozen runner.

findings.summary: Name and design imply restore coverage, but the test bypasses ckpt.restore_learner, exercises no RNG restore, and its RNG equality assertion is trivially true.
findings.fix: Scope claim to exact model/Adam tensors loaded on CPU and hook leaves CPU RNG unchanged.

findings.summary: Rollback branch is untested and unreachable for valid finite positive inputs; math.isfinite on non-numeric input raises TypeError rather than ValueError (still pre-mutation).
findings.fix: Note rollback as defensive only; rely on pre-mutation checks as the atomicity evidence.

findings.summary: Design requires full before/after optimizer fingerprints and LR delta; patch records only fingerprints excluding LR.
findings.fix: Record full parent and effective optimizer fingerprints alongside the excluding-LR fingerprints and LR delta.

findings.summary: Design states as fact that one seed per arm cannot resolve effects below roughly 620 frames; the parent ranking reconciliation qualifies this as an illustrative fixed-cohort approximation, not a training-replicate power proof.
findings.fix: Restate as an illustrative fixed-cohort approximation per the reconciliation; drop the absolute claim. Reconciliation file not opened in this review.

checked_holding: Atomic rejection before first write for config_lr != 1e-4 and any group lr != 3e-4

Source and receipt hashes match the brief
PARENT_SHA and PARENT_RECEIPT_SHA checks preserved at runner.py:22 and :24
